id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_010.pack|cs_: Oh my... what a beautiful town! It looks like a whole town floating right on the sea!
So this is Gondolia, the famous trade town. Rich folk and merchants gather at the biggest port in the world, they say.
Hmm... wait. If Sylvando owns his own ship in a town like this, is he actually some kind of big deal?
Hee hee, Veronica darling. Prying is so unbecoming, don't you think?
My darling ship is resting in the dock on the west side of town. Come along, everyone!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_020.pack|cs_: Ooh, {var:1} darling, listen! This boy is being mean and won't let me into the dock!
N-no, that's not it! There's a contest coming up in town, so the dock is closed right now.
We came all this way for that? So we can't get in until this contest is over?
I'm very sorry. The Mighty Man Contest is a treasured tradition in our town.
The Mighty Man Contest? Ooh, what a tingle that sends through a maiden's heart! Tell me more!
The contest finds the man who is wild as the waves, fresh as the sky, and deep as the sea. A man who has all three!
So this time of year, rugged men proud of their physiques and handsome fellows who suit the sea breeze come flocking to town.
Oh, how fun that sounds! Then let's rest in town a while and see the contest before we set sail.
Oh, Veronica, Serena! The shops here sell lovely clothes and sweets from all over the world.
We've time to spare, so let's make it a girls' trip, shopping and tasting sweets while we wait for the contest!
...I don't care about the contest, but shopping does sound fun. I've been wanting new shoes.
Hey, wait a second. We came to find the Rainbough. We don't have time to play around.
I'm sorry! I can't resist anything sweet!
Listen, we're in a hurry. It'd really help if you'd open the dock. Who's in charge of the contest, anyway?
Why, that would be our mayor, Rotondo, who built Gondolia up to what it is in a single lifetime.
He's kind to everyone and a man of fine character. You should meet him. He'll be at his mansion on the east side of town.
All right, {var:1}. Let's go see the mayor and ask him straight out to open the dock.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_030.pack|cs_: This has to be the mayor's house. All right, let's go.
Welcome. May I ask who you are?
Are you Mayor Rotondo? We'd like to ask you something.
Yes, I'm Rotondo, the mayor. What can I do for...
...I have nothing to say to you. Be gone at once.
He won't give us the time of day. Kind to everyone? Where do they get that?
Also, that mayor gave you a strange look. Don't tell me he's figured out you're wanted...
Oh, {var:1}! Master Erik! There you are.
Actually, something terrible has happened. It's my sister... Could you please help us?
That little squirt is nothing but trouble. Well, we can't sail anyway. Let's go, {var:1}.
